statements.JinWishart.hermitian_ordered_zero_paddin: {a b d : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin a) ℂ} {B : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin b) ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i) (hpoly : B.charpoly = X^d * A.charpoly) : List.ofFn hB.eigenvalues₀ = List.ofFn hA.eigenvalues₀ ++ List.replicate d 0
statements.JinWishart.gram_ordered_column_eq_row_ap: {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) (hmn : m ≤ n) : List.ofFn (complexGram_posSemidef A).1.eigenvalues₀ = List.ofFn (complexGram_posSemidef Aᴴ).1.eigenvalues₀ ++ List.replicate (n-m) 0
statements.JinWishart.gram_ordered_row_column_prefi: {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (i : Fin m) : (complexGram_posSemidef Aᴴ).1.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin m).symm i) = (complexGram_posSemidef A).1.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin n).symm (Fin.castLE hmn i))
